boundaries.evidence: Statement and numbered proof: The zero module and empty reflection arrangement are permitted; zero-dimensional parameter space imposes no excluded hyperplane. Empty Koszul sums and zero ranks satisfy the same identities.

Statement and numbered proof: Zero maps and zero fiber multiplicities are allowed. Quotient kernels and torsion objects are checked by exact localization; no nonzero fiber is assumed without specifying it.
Statement and numbered proof: The trivial group, one-dimensional modules, scalar identity and unit in the Hecke image are included. The D=0 rational-interpolation case is explicit.

Statement and numbered proof: All parameters, including resonance and coincident Hecke roots, are allowed. Nonresonance is used only on a dense parameter set before holomorphic continuation. Quotient equivalence retains exactly dimHecke=|W|.

Statement and numbered proof: Generic-line estimates include every finite puncture and infinity. Bounded-angle sectors and fractional-meridian endpoint maps are explicit; no globally single-valued untwisted determinant section is assumed.

Statement and numbered proof: Only finite bases/lifts and finite group averaging are used. Costandard orthogonality uses a finite projective Koszul resolution and an explicit contraction, avoiding infinite-free projectivity or an added AC premise.

Statement and numbered proof: The full-faithfulness, representability and equivalence directions are proved by actual maps, roofs, precomposition action, or finite presentations; kernel identification uses zero localized fibers.

Statement and numbered proof: The inverse equivalence uses the isomorphism of the Hecke algebra with the opposite projective endomorphism algebra, established by surjectivity and the stated dimension equality. Rational-map regularity and saturation are verified locally.
